scope: evaluation-only renderer copy; official training source, rasterizer, and trained checkpoint remain unmodified

plane_sources.accumulated_alpha: native 2DGS allmap channel 1, equal to 1 minus final transmittance
plane_sources.weighted_camera_z_sum: native 2DGS allmap channel 0, sum of compositing weight times per-ray surfel intersection camera z
plane_sources.weighted_camera_z_second_moment: evaluation-only added sum of compositing weight times camera z squared
plane_sources.weighted_inverse_camera_z_sum: evaluation-only added sum of compositing weight divided by camera z

raw_output.camera_z_definition: positive per-ray 2D surfel intersection z computed by depth=(s.x*Tw.x+s.y*Tw.y)+Tw.z in the frozen official rasterizer
raw_output.alpha_compositing: official alpha cap 0.99, alpha cutoff 1/255, and early termination threshold 1e-4 are unchanged
raw_output.derived_packet_policy: derive normalized fields on CPU from the four raw float32 accumulators

remaining_gate: build official training extensions and isolated patched evaluation rasterizer on the target GPU, pass synthetic raw-moment conformance, then pass actual frozen-3K packet/export/evaluator preflight
